author: perrotta
body:
#### PR description:

Complete migration of ALL GTs in autocond, in order to allow in them the new SiPixelClusterShapeLimitsRcd record introduced with [#52013](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52013), backported  into CMSSW_17_0_X with [#52060](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52060))
The request was introduced and discussed in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/gts-for-the-new-sipixelclustershapelimitsrcd-record/149398)

This is the list of all GTs updated in autoCond, together with their difference with respect to the same GTs previously considered in autoCond:

=== **Data GTs** with the new tag [SiPixelClusterShapeLimits_multiIOV_v1_hlt](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/list/Prod/tags/SiPixelClusterShapeLimits_multiIOV_v1_hlt):

- [170X_dataRun2_v2](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/list/Prod/gts/170X_dataRun2_v2) -> [diff](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/diff/Prod/gts/170X_dataRun2_v2/150X_dataRun2_v1)

=== **Updates and cleanups**

- Profiting of this migration, a few GTs in autoCond were also updated to their most recent version: see the notes attached to the descriptions above for them.
- At the same time, the same cleanup already applied in master has been ported here, and the following two unused keys are here removed:
```
    # GlobalTag for MC production (cosmics) with perfectly aligned and calibrated detector for Phase1 2022, Strip tracker in DECO mode
    'phase1_2022_cosmics_design'   :    '140X_mcRun3_2022cosmics_design_deco_v1',
    # GlobalTag for MC production (cosmics) with perfectly aligned and calibrated detector for Phase1 2024, Strip tracker in DECO mode
    'phase1_2024_cosmics_design'   :    '140X_mcRun3_2024cosmics_design_deco_v11',
```
